knowledge_gaps: Source frequency measures available training evidence, not candidate-specific transition reliability. A frequent source can have diffuse successors, and factorized embeddings can score unobserved edges highly. The gate therefore does not establish that a recommendation has direct behavioral support.

The auxiliary transition loss changes supervision while the report claims to isolate architecture. Include residual-only, auxiliary-loss-only, and combined ablations, plus a parameter-matched baseline.

Reproduction requires explicit loss equations, auxiliary weight, smoothing constant, gate cap and initialization, embedding regularization, padding handling, candidate-scoring tensor shapes, and checkpoint-selection rules. A bounded gate does not bound residual logits when embedding norms grow.

The search plan lacks trial allocations within 43,200 GPU-seconds and safeguards against repeatedly selecting on the same 200 validation users per category. Training margins cannot establish generalization or practical compatibility.

Originality and difficulty ratings need stronger grounding in established sequential matrix-factorization methods. Predictor integration, full-catalog scoring, and diagnostic adaptation make difficulty dependent on more than the small expert architecture.

follow_up_queries.reason: Assess novelty and identify simpler controls before prioritizing the proposed residual over established sequential factorization approaches.
follow_up_queries.query: How do FPMC (Factorizing Personalized Markov Chains), FOSSIL, and related combinations of sequential recommendation and directed item-transition factorization compare with SASRec plus separate source/target embeddings and a learned support gate? What scoring equations and ablations distinguish architectural gains from extra parameters or auxiliary supervision?

follow_up_queries.reason: Determine whether the proposed reliability gate can suppress popularity shortcuts and unsupported successor predictions.
follow_up_queries.query: For sparse implicit-feedback next-item recommendation, how can a directed transition expert estimate candidate-specific reliability using unique-user edge counts, successor entropy, shrinkage, or popularity-normalized transitions? Compare these with source-degree gating n/(n+lambda), including generalization to unobserved edges and control of factorized score norms.

follow_up_queries.reason: Make evaluation and implementation choices defensible under the fixed benchmark and compute budget.
follow_up_queries.query: What reproducible experimental practices address validation-selection overfitting when comparing SASRec transition-residual ablations under a fixed GPU-time budget and sampled HR@10 with 200 users and 99 negatives per dataset? Include paired user-level uncertainty estimates, prespecified checkpoint schedules, compute-matched baselines, and numerical parity checks between training scoring and full-catalog inference.
